risks.proof: Video or photo of the flashlight turning on and showing battery charge indicator or runtime test.

risks.risk: Solar panel may not charge effectively
risks.proof: Video showing the solar panel charging the flashlight under sunlight with a charge indicator or battery level change.

risks.risk: Magnetic base may be weak or damaged
risks.proof: Photo or video showing the flashlight attached to a metal surface and held securely.
risks.if_unproven: priced as weak or non-functional magnetic base

risks.risk: Flashlight may not reach advertised 300M beam distance
risks.proof: Photo or video of the beam projected in a dark environment with a distance marker at 300M or equivalent.

risks.risk: The flashlight may be counterfeit or not genuine W565 model
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the flashlight body showing any brand or model engraving, or a serial number, or a comparison with an authentic W565.

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a W565 work light flashlight with all claimed features supported by the packaging. While some functional claims (like battery, solar charging, beam distance) cannot be verified remotely, they are priced at worst case (non-functional) until proven. The item can be priced based on its worst-case condition as seen.
